user.description: Receives your band's data from the Health Hub phone app. After adding it, set up the phone app with this Home Assistant address and an admin user's long-lived access token.

rebuild_statistics.description: Rewrites all Health Hub long-term statistics from its stored data, for example after an import or a fix.
